snippet.title: Hide 'n Heist Official Teaser | Doin' Together Games
snippet.description:
Presenting Doin' Together Games' first game: Hide 'n Heist!

4 Thieves vs. 1 Guardian! A medieval heist game! Play as a thief, blend into the crowd, and steal the treasure, or take on the role of the guardian and hunt down the thieves! Everyone has a unique role and strategy. Find the right approach and lead your team to victory!

Wishlist Now!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3321300/Hide_n_Heist/
